fields.Name: Start Timer
fields.Description: Starts a stopwatch timer on a task for the given person (defaulting to the current user's linked Person). If a timer is already running for that person on the same task, returns the existing timer idempotently. If a timer is running on a different task, atomically stops it (splitting any cross-midnight interval into business-day TaskTimeEntry rows) and starts the new timer inside one database transaction.

fields.Name: Stop Timer
fields.Description: Stops the active stopwatch timer for the given person (defaulting to the current user's linked Person), converts the elapsed interval into one or more business-day TaskTimeEntry rows with Source = 'Timer' using the person's resolved business timezone, and deletes the TaskTimer row inside one database transaction.

fields.Name: Get Task Effort
fields.Description: Returns the complete human and AI agent effort breakdown for a task, optionally rolled up across all descendant sub-tasks via Task.RootParentID, with ancestor deduplication across linked AI agent runs.

fields.Name: Submit Timesheet
fields.Description: Submits a Draft or Rejected timesheet for a period: stops any running timer whose business date falls in the period, attaches all unlinked TaskTimeEntry rows in [PeriodStart..PeriodEnd], computes TotalMinutes and BillableMinutes, resolves approvers per part (carrying forward unchanged Approved parts on resubmit), and spawns TIMESHEET_APPROVAL tasks in the Tasks inbox inside one database transaction.

fields.Name: Withdraw Timesheet
fields.Description: Withdraws a Submitted timesheet back to Draft so the worker can edit time entries, canceling all Pending TimesheetApproval rows and their backing approval tasks inside one database transaction.

fields.Name: Reopen Timesheet
fields.Description: Reopens an Approved timesheet back to Draft for correction. Requires the Manage Timesheets authorization and a non-empty Reason, and records a TaskActivity audit entry.

fields.Name: Bulk Update Tasks
fields.Description: Performs server-side Asana-grade bulk mutations on up to 500 tasks (reassign, set or shift due/start dates, update status, priority, organization/company scope, category, task type/stage, or attach a tag) through BaseEntity save pipelines with per-task partial-failure reporting.

fields.Name: Instantiate Template
fields.Description: Instantiates a Task Template playbook on the server with relative due-date offsets from StartDate, parent/child hierarchy, TaskDependency wiring, role placeholder assignments, and optional target Organization/Company scoping.

fields.Name: Run Recurring Playbooks
fields.Description: Idempotently instantiates a recurring Task Template playbook (such as Month-End or Quarter-End Financial Close) across explicit Organizations or every active mirrored internal Company (Organization.LinkedCompanyID IS NOT NULL) using a PeriodKey marker to prevent duplicate launches.
